description: This module return information about a container registry on Scaleway account.

parameters.name: api_timeout
parameters.description: HTTP timeout to Scaleway API in seconds. Default: 30

parameters.name: api_token
parameters.description: Scaleway OAuth token. This is required if profile is not specified.

parameters.name: profile
parameters.description: The config profile in config file to load the Scaleway OAuth token from, use instead of api_token. It is also possible to set SCW_PROFILE to use a SCW CLI config profile.

parameters.name: query_parameters
parameters.description: List of parameters passed to the query string. Default: {}

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: Scaleway region to use (for example fr-par). Choices: "fr-par" "nl-ams" "pl-waw"

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: Validate SSL certs of the Scaleway API. Choices: false true ← (default)

examples:
- name: Get a container registry info
  community.general.scaleway_container_registry_info:
    project_id: '{{ scw_project }}'
    region: fr-par
    name: my-awesome-container-registry
  register: container_registry_info_task

return_values.name: container_registry
return_values.description: The container registry information.
